tagline: A global leader in next-generation 4D Imaging Radar Solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The backlog is the primary leading indicator of future demand for 4D radars, a key segment in the adoption of advanced automation and embedded AI.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of orders received but not yet delivered, essential for forecasting future revenues.
kpis.description: Backlog stands at $2.0M as of September 30, 2021, primarily related to prototyping and technical pilot projects.
kpis.signal: Stable backlog despite low revenue, indicating commercial traction.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales generated by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue of $0.6M in Q3 2021, totaling $1.7M over the first nine months of 2021.
kpis.signal: Revenues still very low, typical of a company in pre-production phase.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount spent on research and development of new products.
kpis.description: R&D expenses reached $7.4M in Q3 2021, compared to $2.9M a year earlier.
kpis.signal: R&D sharply increasing, reflecting investment in 4D radar technology.

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total costs related to the operation of the business.
kpis.description: Operating expenses amounted to $8.5M in Q3 2021, compared to $3.4M in 2020.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in expenses, driven by team expansion and increased activities.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Amount of loss after all costs and charges.
kpis.description: Net loss of $13.3M in Q3 2021, including $5.0M in financial charges related to the revaluation of convertible debt.
kpis.signal: Net loss significantly increased, impacted by one-time financial charges from the revaluation of convertible debt.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and non-recurring charges.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA of -$8.0M in Q3 2021, compared to -$3.3M in 2020.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDA sharply deteriorating, but reflects investment in growth.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Amount of short-term liquidity available, including short-term deposits.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the balance sheet includes $4 million in cash and cash equivalents and $40.7 million in short-term bank deposits, totaling $44.7M.
kpis.signal: Consolidated cash position of $44.7M as of December 31, 2025, consisting of $4M in cash and $40.7M in short-term bank deposits.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.07 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Projected Revenue 2025
kpis.explanation: Anticipated revenue for 2025 based on identified projects.
kpis.description: Arbe targets $312M in revenue by 2025, reflecting strong expected growth following the development phase.
kpis.signal: Ambitious target of $312M in 2025, based on projects under development and validation.

kpis.name: Total Addressable Market
kpis.explanation: Total size of the potential market for the company's technology.
kpis.description: The total addressable market is estimated at $11B by 2025, driven by demand for radars in autonomous vehicles.
kpis.signal: TAM of $11B in 2025 represents significant growth potential in the 4D radar segment for autonomy.

risks.title: Critical dependence on Tier-1 suppliers' integration decisions
risks.score_rationale: Major risk located at the top of the Risk Factors section (high position). Intense language: « will be impacted to the extent that manufacturers select a Tier-1 supplier that does not use our chipsets ». Stable but structural trend. High category weight: business model entirely dependent on adoption by Tier 1s.

risks.title: Very long development cycles and risk of order cancellation
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly detailed in dedicated section. Strong language: « lengthy development cycles », « cancel or postpone orders for any reason ». Trend up: highlighted as an increasing impact factor during the transition to production. Critical category weight for a startup in commercialization phase.

risks.title: Delays in ADAS/AV deployment by automobile manufacturers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned twice in the text with warning language: « delays by automobile manufacturers », « re-evaluating or postponing large-scale rollout of Level 3 systems ». Trend up: strategic shift in the market toward L4 at the expense of L3. Very high category weight: directly affects demand for 4D radars.

risks.title: Geopolitical and operational risks related to Israel-based operations
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly developed in the text: « wars with Iran and Lebanon », « missiles and drones fired at Israel », « call-up of significant portion of Israel's working population ». Trend up: current situation (2025) with ongoing hostilities. High category weight: direct impact on operations and key personnel.

risks.title: Dependence on GlobalFoundries for manufacturing and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in outsourcing strategy: « engagement of GlobalFoundries for manufacturing and supply chain management ». Moderate language but strategically critical. Stable trend but structural vulnerability. High category weight: transition to production fully dependent on this partner.

risks.title: 4D radar technology not yet validated at commercial scale
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk: « R&D program may not produce successful results », « products may not achieve market acceptance ». Cautious language but fundamental. Stable trend. Very high category weight: entire value proposition relies on the technological superiority of 4D radar vs LiDAR and competing radars.

risks.title: History of significant losses and lack of demonstrated profitability
risks.score_rationale: Factual data: net losses of $46.4M (2025), $49.3M (2024), $43.5M (2023) against revenues of $1M, $0.8M, $1.5M respectively. Language: « No assurance can be made that we can or will become profitable ». Stable but structural trend. High category weight: financial viability uncertain.

risks.title: Need for additional funding to execute business plan
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: « may need to raise additional funds in the future », « funds may not be available when we need them ». Moderate warning language. Trend up: increasing dependence as transition to production approaches. High category weight: shareholder dilution and funding risk.

ai_positioning.summary: Arbe integrates AI into its software layer to enhance 4D radar perception, but does not position itself as a primary AI player. Its approach focuses on applying AI to sensing and embedded safety.
evidence: Arbe's AI layer is receiving strong feedback following pilot trials from leading automotive companies
The company's 4D Imaging Radar uses AI for advanced sensing and perception
AI is embedded in the Phoenix Perception Radar for real-time object classification
